body.text:
listen: 127.0.0.1:<PORT>
models:
  amazon-nova:
    provider: bedrock
    max_concurrent: 10
    max_requests: -1
    upstream_model: amazon.nova-pro-v1:0
pools:
  upstream_credentials: own
  claude-code:
    members:
    - model: amazon-nova
      weight: 1
advanced:
  response_headers:
    server_timing: true
providers:
  bedrock:
    api_key:
      env: AWS_BEDROCK_CREDS
auth:
  chain:
  - keys
  signing_key:
    env: BUSBAR_SIGNING_KEY
  admin_auth:
  - admin-tokens
identity-providers:
  admin-tokens:
    module: admin-tokens
    token:
      env: BUSBAR_ADMIN_TOKEN
